activity.notes: The 1960 Constitution made Kwame Nkrumah the first President of Ghana when the republic began on 1 July 1960. His presidency ended with the military-police coup of 24 February 1966.

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Ghana, 1960 — GhaLII
sources.citation_text: The Constitution commenced on 1 July 1960 and expressly appointed Kwame Nkrumah as first President of Ghana.

sources.title: Ghana Background Note — U.S. Department of State
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State historical background records the republican constitution of 1 July 1960 and the overthrow of Nkrumah's government on 24 February 1966.
